output.body:
## Summary

```text
StageRuntime → retained two-layer background
World camera deltas → parallax
pause / efficiency actions → stop / ordinary or forced resume
MainBackgroundView → gradient + replacement pixels → Main capture / shake / flash
```

Replace decorative menu circles and wrapping game dust with the recovered background from merged #37. Keep it alive across menu, Credits and gameplay; remove duplicate production painting. This completes the renderer/wiring slice of original bf202f6, with later series-strip work separate.

## Evidence

- **Before:** menu and gameplay use separate approximate backgrounds; shared particle state is unused.
  **After:** both use the imported gradient and two pixel layers at half opacity. Controlled browser probes cover transparent replacement, negative-fraction truncation, dead-current paint and layer composition. Native/mock flows cover animation, paused pixels, repeated forced Efficiency Off and capture/effect integration.
- Formatting, TypeScript,463 rule/parser tests /5818 assertions and production build pass. All16 affected native/mock menu, Credits, game, Main-effects and settings-session cases pass; the final61-case mock/synthetic plus native menu/Credits/pause selection passes.
- Independent source caller audit confirms ordinary/transit deltas, no arrival teleport, accumulation while stopped and forced Off semantics. Existing exact mask regression, zoom-aware contact and preferred-FPS assertions remain intact.
- Native Credits was visually inspected against the stored original Ruffle capture: backdrop/foreground placement is consistent, with unsynchronized particles, text pixels, guest/version and local feedback still differing. No media or generated data changes.
- Exact cross-target ENTER_FRAME order, global RNG/phase, React screen-exit timing, Flash channel rounding and Freeze color transforms remain open. Current post-world scheduling is explicit; source registration chronology alone does not prove dispatch order. Full background/menu/game parity is unproven; see docs/fidelity.md.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** presentation

Changes shared background paint, capture and pause/efficiency behavior. Simulation only reports camera deltas; gameplay rules and existing input/contact callbacks remain intact.

output.body:
## Summary

```text
SWF524 → numerical timelines / paint / text layout
source hover rules → retained MenuSeriesMotion
MainMenuMotion → shared child lifetime
historical destinations → disconnected LegacyWebsites adapter
native/mock painting and browser controls → separate follow-up
```

Recover the “More Bubbletanks” strip before connecting its visible controls. This builds on #38; the nonpainting mask correction from merged #36 remains intact.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the series strip has no retained timeline or layout model.
  **After:** five source-contract tests cover stopped frames1/10, link births4/6/8/10, widths131/401, all opening/closing reversal pairs, intermediate child recreation, parent lifetime and four disconnected destinations.
- Formatting, TypeScript,468 rule/parser tests /5890 assertions and production build pass. The renderer does not consume this model yet; affected visible browser flows follow with the UI slice.
- Both numerical imports reproduce twice and match the backlog bytes. Raw SpriteHeader/FrameLabel/PlaceObject2 inspection independently confirms19 frames, labels1/2/10/11 and link birth frames. FFDec SVG metadata/text exports corroborate bounds, opening/closing fill alpha and copy. Source and bytecode agree on stop/reversal/URL behavior.
- Imports contain only numerical placements, bounds, paint and text/glyph layout, with no contours, artwork or media. Historical URL strings are inactive metadata; the adapter throws local unavailable feedback without opening them.
- Native/mock painting, hit contours, DOM/Flash event delivery, constructor/global phase and font/filter pixels remain for follow-up. Complete menu/game parity is unproven; docs/fidelity.md records the evidence and limits.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** model

Adds a retained child model and import tools; visible menu behavior is unchanged until the separate integration PR.

output.body:
## Summary

```text
SWF524 → numerical timelines / paint / text layout
source hover rules → retained MenuSeriesMotion
MainMenuMotion → shared child lifetime
historical destinations → disconnected LegacyWebsites adapter
native/mock painting and browser controls → separate follow-up
```

Recover the “More Bubbletanks” strip before connecting its visible controls. This builds on merged #38; the nonpainting mask correction from merged #36 remains intact.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the series strip has no retained timeline or layout model.
  **After:** five source-contract tests cover stopped frames1/10, link births4/6/8/10, widths131/401, all opening/closing reversal pairs, intermediate child recreation, parent lifetime and four disconnected destinations.
- Formatting, TypeScript,468 rule/parser tests /5890 assertions and production build pass. The renderer does not consume this model yet; affected visible browser flows follow with the UI slice.
- Both numerical imports reproduce twice and match the backlog bytes. Raw SpriteHeader/FrameLabel/PlaceObject2 inspection independently confirms19 frames, labels1/2/10/11 and link birth frames. FFDec SVG metadata/text exports corroborate bounds, opening/closing fill alpha and copy. Source and bytecode agree on stop/reversal/URL behavior.
- Imports contain only numerical placements, bounds, paint and text/glyph layout, with no contours, artwork or media. Historical URL strings are inactive metadata; the adapter throws local unavailable feedback without opening them.
- Native/mock painting, hit contours, DOM/Flash event delivery, constructor/global phase and font/filter pixels remain for follow-up. Complete menu/game parity is unproven; docs/fidelity.md records the evidence and limits.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** model

Adds a retained child model and import tools; visible menu behavior is unchanged until the separate integration PR.
